title: A turn the sr2 gateway's own first-byte deadline cut (https://github.com/manaflow-ai/cmux/issues/57823): the card says the gateway did not answer and never reached the model, not "rate limited or out of capacity", with Retry and Switch model. The fake agent fails every prompt with the gateway's exact error (FAKE_PROMPT_ERROR). Record with: cmux-ci capture SHA --state scripts/cmux-next/media/states/turn-failure-gateway-stalled.json

env.FAKE_PROMPT_ERROR: API Error: 503 subrouter gateway had no response within 1m0s (before the upstream call); retry. This is a server-side issue, usually temporary — try again in a moment. If it persists, check your inference gateway (127.0.0.1:58741).
